name: Unified Path-based Photon Path (UPBP) Recursive Weight Calculation
aliases: Unified Path-Based Path Tracing recursive weight
definition: A method to compute path weights for BPT and PDE estimators by maintaining and updating recursive quantities $d_i^{	ext{shared}}$, $d_i^{	ext{BPT}}$, and $d_i^{	ext{PDE}}$ at each vertex $i$ during subpath tracing, avoiding the storage of full path weights.
